DeviceCodeFlowCallback.summary: Optional device-code-flow callback invoked for SqlAuthenticationMethod.ActiveDirectoryDeviceCodeFlow. When , the provider's default callback (which writes the device-code instructions to the console) is used.

ApplicationClientId.summary: Optional Entra ID application (client) id. When , the SqlClient first-party application id is used and WAM broker mode is forced on (regardless of ) when running on Windows.

UseWamBroker.summary: Windows-only setting to control whether the provider uses the WAM broker for interactive authentication. Defaults to when you provide a custom . Otherwise, WAM broker mode is used automatically on Windows.
UseWamBroker.remarks: Setting this property to does not disable WAM for SqlClient's first-party application ID, including when that ID is supplied explicitly. Disabling WAM requires a custom application registration. WAM interactive authentication requires a valid parent window handle. Applications with a window can supply its handle using . Windowless hosts should use a non-interactive credential with Authentication=Active Directory Default, or use their own application registration with WAM disabled if interactive sign-in is required.
